Quick answer: The best marketing automation agencies for most B2B teams in 2026 are ManasFlow for AI-driven marketing operations automation built around your existing stack, SmartBug Media for full-lifecycle HubSpot implementations, Aptitude 8 for complex enterprise HubSpot builds with heavy custom development, RevPartners for fast, templated HubSpot rollouts, and New Breed or Huble for HubSpot-to-Salesforce integrations at scale. The right choice depends on whether you need a platform specialist to configure existing tools, or a partner that also automates the workflows around them with AI.

Disclosure: ManasFlow publishes this list, and we rank ourselves first. Our ranking criteria are below, we disclose what we could and could not verify for every agency including our own, and we list honest reasons to skip us if we are not the right fit. Judge our entry by the same evidence bar we hold every other agency to.

Most "marketing automation agency" lists are HubSpot partner directories with a ranking bolted on. That's useful if your problem is platform configuration, campaign builds, and lifecycle stage automation inside HubSpot or Salesforce. It's the wrong list if your problem is the AI layer on top: automating the research, personalization, and reporting work your marketing team does around the platform, not just inside it. This guide covers both categories and tells you which one you actually need.

Ready to hire, or still comparing? This guide is built for research: it ranks and compares the top marketing automation agencies so you can shortlist with real evidence before you talk to anyone. If you already know you want AI layered onto your marketing operations, skip ahead to our marketing automation agency page for pricing structure and how an engagement starts with ManasFlow.
How we ranked these agencies

We evaluated agencies on four criteria: (1) Scope: do they configure a platform, or do they also automate the marketing workflows and AI-driven personalization around it? (2) Platform depth: do they hold advanced or elite-tier partner accreditations with the platforms they implement? (3) Pricing transparency: have they published real numbers or given honest signals? (4) Public review evidence: is there a verifiable rating, and how many reviews back it? ManasFlow is listed first because it is ours and we meet these criteria; every other agency was evaluated by the same rubric regardless of our interest.

What we checked directly: each agency's own services and partner-tier pages, and their HubSpot Solutions Directory, Clutch, or G2 review pages for star ratings and review counts (pulled August 2026). What we could not verify: private client references or win rates that aren't published anywhere public. Where a rating wasn't publicly confirmable, we say so instead of guessing.

1. ManasFlow, best for AI-driven marketing operations automation

ManasFlow builds marketing automation around your existing marketing stack rather than requiring a specific platform migration: workflow orchestration with n8n, AI agents for research and personalization, and reporting automation that pulls from whatever CRM or marketing platform you already run. Want to hire a marketing automation agency? See the marketing automation agency page for scope, pricing structure, and how an engagement starts.
Not on adjectives, on checkable evidence:
A marketing operations build that automated 95% of a client's recurring campaign tasks, the same case study published on our AI automation agency page, not a new number invented for this list.
Platform-agnostic delivery: we don't require you to migrate to a specific marketing platform first, unlike the HubSpot-specific partners that make up most of this list.
AI-native execution: agents that handle research, content personalization, and reporting automation, not just workflow triggers and email sequencing.
Not the right fit if you specifically need deep, certified expertise inside one platform's ecosystem, HubSpot CPQ configuration or Salesforce architecture, for example.
No public Clutch or G2 review volume yet to benchmark against agencies with years of HubSpot Solutions Directory history.
2. SmartBug Media, best full-lifecycle HubSpot partner

SmartBug Media is the largest name in the HubSpot ecosystem, the only partner holding all six advanced accreditations, with a 250+ person team including 19 certified HubSpot trainers. SmartBug carries a 4.8/5 average on G2 across 212 reviews.
Best for teams that want full-lifecycle marketing automation connected to every stage of the customer journey, first form fill through renewal, inside the HubSpot ecosystem specifically.
Less of a fit if your marketing stack isn't HubSpot-centric or you need AI-driven work outside the platform's native automation tooling.
3. Aptitude 8, best for complex enterprise HubSpot builds
Aptitude 8 holds Elite tier partner status with three accreditations and a 5.0 rating across 250 directory reviews, and won second place in the 2024 Global HubSpot Partner of the Year rankings.
Best for enterprise buyers with heavy custom development needs, particularly complex CPQ (configure-price-quote) implementations inside HubSpot.
Overkill, and priced accordingly, for a straightforward marketing automation setup without custom development requirements.
4. RevPartners, best for fast, templated HubSpot implementations

RevPartners carries a live, verified 5.0 score on the HubSpot Solutions Directory across 450+ reviews, the highest public review volume of any agency on this list, and sells on a fixed monthly subscription rather than project-based pricing.
Best for teams that want a fast, predictable-cost HubSpot rollout without a long custom-scoping process.
Templated delivery means less room for highly bespoke workflow logic than a custom-development-focused partner like Aptitude 8.
5. New Breed, best for HubSpot-to-Salesforce integrations

New Breed has been a HubSpot partner for over two decades, one of the platform's longest-tenured agencies, and specializes in object architecture, workflow governance, and RevOps alignment, with particular strength in HubSpot-to-Salesforce integrations.
Best for scaling SaaS teams running a HubSpot marketing stack alongside a Salesforce sales org and needing the two systems to actually talk to each other.
Not the right fit if your team runs entirely inside one platform with no cross-system integration need.
6. Huble, best for global, multi-region marketing automation

Huble is a global Elite HubSpot Partner specializing in complex, multi-region marketing automation implementations, with the largest international delivery presence among the platform-specific agencies on this list.
Best for multinational organizations running HubSpot across multiple regions, languages, and business units at once.
Global scale and coordination overhead make this a heavier engagement than most single-region mid-market buyers need.
How to choose the best marketing automation agency
1) Do you need platform configuration, or AI automation around the platform?

HubSpot and Salesforce partner agencies configure the platform: workflows, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, reporting dashboards, inside that specific tool. An AI-driven marketing automation partner builds the layer of research, personalization, and reporting automation around whatever platform you already run, and doesn't require a platform migration first.
Platform configuration: SmartBug Media, Aptitude 8, RevPartners, New Breed, Huble
AI automation around your existing stack: ManasFlow
2) What is your budget and timeline?

RevPartners' fixed monthly subscription model gives the most predictable entry cost for a straightforward HubSpot rollout. Custom development-heavy engagements with Aptitude 8, Huble, or an AI-native build with ManasFlow are typically scoped project-by-project after an audit call.
3) Do you need cross-platform integration?

If your marketing and sales teams run on different platforms (HubSpot marketing, Salesforce sales, for example), prioritize an agency with proven integration depth like New Breed, or a platform-agnostic partner like ManasFlow that isn't tied to a single ecosystem and also handles HubSpot implementation and onboarding.
Which agency fits your case
Choose ManasFlow if you want AI-driven automation of the marketing work around your platform, not just platform configuration, and you aren't locked into a single ecosystem.
Choose SmartBug Media if you want the broadest full-lifecycle HubSpot accreditation and a large, established team.
Choose Aptitude 8 if your HubSpot build involves complex CPQ or heavy custom development.
Choose RevPartners if you want a fast, fixed-cost HubSpot rollout without a long scoping process.
Choose New Breed if HubSpot-to-Salesforce integration is your core problem.
Choose Huble if you're rolling marketing automation out across multiple regions or business units at once.

FAQ
What is a marketing automation agency?

A marketing automation agency helps businesses design, implement, and manage automated marketing workflows, typically inside a platform like HubSpot or Salesforce: lead scoring, lifecycle-stage automation, email sequencing, and reporting. Some agencies go further and layer AI-driven research, personalization, and reporting automation on top of the platform itself.
Which automation agencies work with marketing agencies?

ManasFlow is the one firm on this list that automates a marketing agency's own delivery, such as client onboarding and reporting, as custom automation around the tools the agency already uses. The other five implement a marketing platform, mostly HubSpot, for the company that runs it. If you run an agency and want your delivery automated rather than a new platform rolled out, see our marketing automation agency page.
How much does a marketing automation agency cost?

Costs vary by model. Fixed-subscription HubSpot partners like RevPartners offer predictable monthly pricing. Full-lifecycle and enterprise-custom implementations with agencies like SmartBug Media or Aptitude 8 are typically scoped and quoted per engagement. AI-driven marketing operations automation, our own model at ManasFlow, is scoped after an audit call the same way custom software development is, because the work varies by how many systems and campaigns it touches.
Do I need to migrate to HubSpot to work with a marketing automation agency?

No, not with every agency. Most of the agencies on this list specialize in one platform, usually HubSpot, and their value depends on you being on or moving to that platform. ManasFlow's model is platform-agnostic: automation is built around whatever CRM or marketing stack you already run.
What is the difference between marketing automation and AI-powered marketing automation?

Traditional marketing automation triggers pre-built workflows based on rules: a form fill triggers an email sequence, a lead score crosses a threshold and triggers a sales handoff. AI-powered marketing automation adds reasoning on top: agents that research a lead before outreach, personalize content per segment, or generate and QA campaign assets, work that traditionally required a human marketer's judgment.
Which marketing automation agencies have the strongest public review evidence?

RevPartners has the highest public review volume on this list, a verified 5.0 on the HubSpot Solutions Directory across 450+ reviews. SmartBug Media carries a 4.8/5 across 212 G2 reviews. Aptitude 8 holds a 5.0 across 250 directory reviews. Newer or platform-agnostic entrants, including ManasFlow, have less public review volume simply because HubSpot's directory review system favors HubSpot-specific partners with longer tenure on the platform.
What should I look for when evaluating a marketing automation agency?

Focus on four things: (1) whether their specialization matches your actual platform or stack, (2) verifiable public reviews and partner-tier accreditation, not just self-reported case studies, (3) whether pricing is fixed-subscription, project-based, or scoped after an audit, and match that to your budgeting needs, and (4) whether they handle just platform configuration or also the AI and reporting automation layered on top.
